# CANDIDATE: LUNCH_LULL_VWAP_MEANREV_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

During lunch lull (12:00-13:45 ET), volatility compresses and price tends to revert to VWAP after deviating beyond 1.5 ATR(20), offering a short-term mean-reversion opportunity. This edge exists because low-volume, low-vol periods often lack directional conviction, allowing price to snap back to the intraday average.

## Mechanism

Entry: Between 12:00 and 13:45 ET, if ATR(20) < 0.5 × the 20-period ATR average from 09:30-11:00, and price deviates > 1.5 × ATR(20) from intraday VWAP, then enter opposite direction (short if price > VWAP, long if price < VWAP) at the close of the candle that first exceeds the deviation threshold, provided volume < average volume of the prior 20 minutes.
Exit: Chart-stop at VWAP, TP1 at 1R, runner using chandelier trail (ATR×2).
